Class CoMoMBasis

java.lang.Object
solvers.basis.Basis
solvers.basis.CoMoMBasis
Direct Known Subclasses:
BTFCoMoMBasis
public class CoMoMBasis extends Basis
A class to encapsulate the Basis of CoMoM The basis is intialised according to the initial conditions of CoMoM. An ordered list of PopulationChangeVectors is generated to provide the indexOf() functionality i.e. to return the index of a normalising constant in the basis. Subclasses can specify a Comparator to sort this list as they choose. Subclasses can specify a Comparator to sort this list as they choose.
